item.text: {"classifications":[{"segment_id":"1","code":0,"rationale":"This is commemorative background and a description of Congress's designation and request; it directs no agency and changes no legal rights.","evidence":"The Congress, by House Joint Resolution 259, has designated November 30, 1985, as \"National Mark Twain Day\" and authorized and requested the President to issue a proclamation in observance of this event."},{"segment_id":"2","code":0,"rationale":"The President ceremonially proclaims a national observance, without governing agencies or altering legal rights or duties.","evidence":"do hereby proclaim November 30, 1985, as National Mark Twain Day."},{"segment_id":"3","code":0,"rationale":"This is a hortatory public appeal to observe the commemorative day, not a mandatory governmental direction or legal consequence.","evidence":"I call upon the people of the United States to observe such day with appropriate ceremonies and activities."}]}
